review.common_bounds_review: A successful path has at most 128 job durations and 127 edge lags, each at most 1,000,000; maximum finish is 255,000,000. review.common_bounds_review: The common deadline is the unchanged earliest makespan, at most 255,000,000 for 128 durations and 127 lags each bounded by 1,000,000. Initial latest starts are deadline minus duration. Reverse topological propagation subtracts the edge lag and prerequisite duration; feasibility of the earliest schedule ensures final latest starts are at least earliest starts. All timing, latest and slack values fit signed i64. Empty graphs skip the passes and emit critical:[]; errors return before success-field construction.

Schema remains first and buffers remain bounded: scratch has 128 entries and done has exactly the job count; empty ranges cause no accesses.
